mapper.select: SELECT pa.id, pa.project_id AS projectId, pa.engineer_id AS engineerId, eu.name AS engineerName, eu.username AS engineerUsername, eu.phone AS engineerPhone, pa.assigned_by AS assignedBy, au.name AS assignedByName, pa.assigned_at AS assignedAt, pa.is_active AS isActive, pa.remark, pa.permission_scope AS permissionScope, pa.expire_at AS expireAt, pa.revoke_reason AS revokeReason, pa.revoked_at AS revokedAt FROM biz_project_assignment pa INNER JOIN sys_user eu ON pa.engineer_id = eu.id INNER JOIN sys_user au ON pa.assigned_by = au.id WHERE pa.project_id = #{projectId} AND pa.is_active = 1 ORDER BY pa.assigned_at DESC, pa.id DESC
